title: Create the simple software-factory architecture scaffold
intent: Create a project folder with architecture documentation, necessary deterministic architecture-doc CLI, tool-neutral agent skills, and a task/stage record, using only explicit root-manifest requirements and clearly obvious consequences.

in: Create doc/architecture with agent-readable draft architecture pages and generated index.
Create doc/tools with a deterministic Python CLI for architecture docs and tests.
Create doc/skills with create-task, go-to-task and задокументируй drafts from the root manifest.
Create this task.json and stage plan/evidence record without creating task.md.
Require four-digit task_number and deterministic source key naming: Jira bare number, UI/user input with UI prefix, all other sources with explicit prefix.
out: Do not copy the root manifest into simple/.
Do not choose trackers, product repositories, branches/releases, CI vendors, model providers or an agent runtime.
Do not implement the future code-scanning program, code graph, MCP integrations, subagent orchestration, or a pilot.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The simple/ project contains a domain-first doc/architecture example whose claims are limited to the root manifest; unresolved decisions are marked rather than guessed.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect architecture Markdown and run arch validate/index check.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The doc/tools Python CLI can list/show docs, build/check index.json, validate frontmatter/schema/IDs/links, and has passing automated tests.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Run the documented CLI commands and unittest suite.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The doc/skills folder contains tool-neutral drafts for create-task, go-to-task and задокументируй consistent with the manifest constraints.
A single task.json plus stage plan/evidence are present; no task.md or copied root manifest is created.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect task paths and project tree.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every task has exactly four decimal digits; Jira task keys have no prefix, UI user-input tasks use UI-, and other sources require an explicit prefix. Invalid combinations are rejected and no number is auto-allocated.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Run `doc/tests/run.sh` and inspect the task-key CLI cases.

constraints: task.json is the only canonical task input.
CLI performs deterministic operations; agent/skills own semantic decisions.
Do not implement a pilot or make choices marked unresolved in the manifest.
open_questions: The final task.json JSON Schema is not yet approved; this input is explicitly marked draft-0.2.
No product repository, release mapping, CI system, code owner roster, or canonical shared docs-repository URL is configured.
UI-0001 is a local scaffold fixture number only; no global allocator or reservation is implied.
approvals: No product release, push, merge or deploy is requested by this documentation scaffold.
